podcast.body: Lene Lovich's debut album, featuring her breakthrough single "Lucky Number," was released around the same time Kate Bush was debuting on the charts in 1978. It was released through Stiff Records, an indie label at the forefront of punk and new wave music. "The result was now called stateless and it features this single."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
